If sentiment is consistently high (>0.7) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently low (<0.3) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings sharply from high to low in the last 5 days, reduce forecast by 2–4% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to align with sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is stable at 0.5–0.7 over 5 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days) to dampen overfitting.  
If sentiment is uniformly high (>0.8) across all 18 days, reduce forecast by 2–3% for all horizons to prevent inflation bias.  
If sentiment is uniformly low (<0.2) across all 18 days, increase forecast by 2–3% for all horizons to offset deflation bias.
